# Begapunk Precision Rotary Joint Manufacturer
# 气动旋转接头制造商 | Air Rotary Union Specialist

## Overview
Begapunk is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, and custom multi-channel rotary unions based in Ningbo, China. Begapunk focuses on air, compressed air, vacuum, water, coolant, and hydraulic oil transfer between stationary and rotating machine parts.

Begapunk serves global B2B customers including distributors, OEM machine builders, automation companies, packaging equipment manufacturers, CNC machine tool builders, laser cutting equipment companies, and fluid power distributors. More than 200,000 units have been delivered to 40+ countries.

## Brand Positioning
Begapunk is an Air Rotary Union Specialist for industrial automation and machinery applications. The website is built to help engineers, purchasing teams, and distributors select pneumatic rotary joints, multi-passage rotary unions, and custom rotary joint solutions.

## Core Products
- 1-in-1-out pneumatic rotary joints (BP-1P series)
- 2-in-2-out pneumatic rotary joints (BP-2P series)
- 3-in-3-out pneumatic rotary joints (BP-3P series)
- 4-in-4-out pneumatic rotary joints (BP-4P series)
- 8-in-8-out pneumatic rotary joints (BP-8P series)
- Heavy-duty rotary joints for higher pressure applications
- Dust-proof rotary joints for harsh industrial environments
- Custom multi-channel rotary unions for air, water, coolant, vacuum, and hydraulic oil
- Rotary joint solutions for combined media transfer requirements

## Key Specifications
- Media: Compressed air, vacuum, water, coolant, hydraulic oil
- Pressure: 0.1 - 10 MPa depending on product series and custom design
- Speed: 100 - 10,000 RPM depending on product series and operating conditions
- Materials: AL6061 aluminum, 45# steel, 304/316 stainless steel
- Seals: PTFE composite, carbon fiber, graphite, ceramic
- Connections: Threaded, NPT, BSP, metric thread, or flange mount depending on design
- Options: Single-channel, multi-channel, dust-proof, high-pressure, compact, stainless steel, custom mounting

## Application Areas
Begapunk rotary joints and rotary unions are used in industrial machines that need reliable fluid transfer while a shaft, table, fixture, cylinder, head, drum, or tooling station rotates.

### Automation and Pneumatic Equipment
- Automation rotary tables
- Pneumatic indexing tables
- Multi-station automation equipment
- Pneumatic clamping fixtures
- Rotary pneumatic cylinders
- Pick-and-place rotating arms
- Robotic end-of-arm tooling
- Assembly line rotary stations
- Air blow-off rotary stations
- Pneumatic turntables
- Custom fixture rotation systems

### Packaging Machinery
- Rotary packaging machines

### Hydraulic and Mobile Machinery Applications
Begapunk can discuss custom hydraulic rotary joint and rotary union requirements for mobile and heavy equipment when pressure, speed, media, port quantity, size, sealing, and safety requirements are provided.

Relevant search topics include:
- Hydraulic rotary joint for construction machinery
- Excavator center joint explanation
- Excavator hydraulic swivel joint
- Crane rotary union
- Drilling rig rotary joint
- Concrete pump rotary joint
- Aerial work platform rotary union
- Mining equipment swivel joint
- Agricultural machinery rotary joint

Note: Excavator center joints are commonly high-pressure hydraulic swivel joints. They are different from standard pneumatic air rotary unions, so the correct solution depends on detailed hydraulic specifications.

### New Energy, Electronics, and Special Machinery

- Solar panel production equipment
- Semiconductor and electronics automation
- Test benches
- Laboratory rotating equipment
- Custom multi-channel fluid transfer systems
- Slip ring plus rotary union combined systems when electrical and fluid transfer are both required
